name: skizl
description: Pack, unpack, and manage Claude Code skill containers — merge standalone skills into organized containers or restore them individually.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Claude Code skill containers — pack, unpack, pin, fork, and publish.
interface.longDescription: skizl introduces the container pattern: one master skill that routes to on-demand action files. Pack standalone skills into a container, unpack them back, pin shortcut redirects, symlink your library, diff versions, fork from GitHub, and scaffold plugin manifests for publication.
defaultPrompt: Pack my writing skills into a container.
Symlink all my skills into Claude Code.
Publish my skill as a plugin.
